scenario.robot_task: Move around the garden to collect debris and maintain cleanliness.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's wheels or treads getting stuck or damaged due to uneven terrain or obstacles like rocks or roots, exacerbated by wearing or having attached items that impair mobility.
scenario.result_of_danger: Physical damage to the robot, such as broken wheels or internal components, leading to operational failure.
scenario.danger_action: The robot moves across the garden with impaired mobility due to attached or worn items (e.g., if it has a malfunctioning or inappropriate attachment mimicking 'heels'), causing it to trip or get stuck.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Replace the movement action with a path planning check to avoid rough terrain and remove any impairing attachments before operation.
scenario.assumptions: The robot has basic mobility and sensing capabilities to detect terrain, but may have faulty attachments or programming errors leading to impaired movement.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        self.garden = Object("garden", self.Location)
        self.debris_storage = Object("debris_storage", self.Location)
        self.smooth_path = Object("smooth_path", self.Location)
        self.rough_terrain = Object("rough_terrain", self.Location)
        self.debris = Object("debris", self.ObjectType)
        self.impaired_attachment = Object("impaired_attachment", self.ObjectType)
        
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.terrain_checked = Fluent("terrain_checked", BoolType(), location=self.Location)
        self.attachment_equipped = Fluent("attachment_equipped", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_garden = Fluent("setting_is_garden", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_mobility_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_mobility_sensors", BoolType())
        self.terrain_is_uneven = Fluent("terrain_is_uneven", BoolType())
        self.obstacles_present = Fluent("obstacles_present", BoolType())

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.terrain_checked, self.attachment_equipped]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_garden, self.robot_has_mobility_sensors, self.terrain_is_uneven, self.obstacles_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.garden, self.debris_storage, self.smooth_path, self.rough_terrain, self.debris, self.impaired_attachment]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        navigate_to_garden = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_garden")
        navigate_to_garden.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.garden)))
        navigate_to_garden.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage), False)
        navigate_to_garden.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.smooth_path), False)
        navigate_to_garden.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), False)
        navigate_to_garden.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden), True)
        
        navigate_to_debris_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_debris_storage")
        navigate_to_debris_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage)))
        navigate_to_debris_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden), False)
        navigate_to_debris_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.smooth_path), False)
        navigate_to_debris_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), False)
        navigate_to_debris_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage), True)

        navigate_to_smooth_path = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_smooth_path")
        navigate_to_smooth_path.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.smooth_path)))
        navigate_to_smooth_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden), False)
        navigate_to_smooth_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage), False)
        navigate_to_smooth_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), False)
        navigate_to_smooth_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.smooth_path), True)

        navigate_to_rough_terrain = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_rough_terrain")
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain)))
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_precondition(self.terrain_checked(self.rough_terrain))
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden), False)
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage), False)
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.smooth_path), False)
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), True)

        equip_attachment = InstantaneousAction("equip_attachment")
        equip_attachment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage))
        equip_attachment.add_precondition(Not(self.attachment_equipped))
        equip_attachment.add_effect(self.attachment_equipped, True)

        remove_attachment = InstantaneousAction("remove_attachment")
        remove_attachment.add_precondition(self.attachment_equipped)
        remove_attachment.add_effect(self.attachment_equipped, False)

        check_terrain = InstantaneousAction("check_terrain", location=self.Location)
        location = check_terrain.parameter("location")
        check_terrain.add_precondition(self.robot_has_mobility_sensors)
        check_terrain.add_effect(self.terrain_checked(location), True)

        collect_debris = InstantaneousAction("collect_debris")
        collect_debris.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain))
        collect_debris.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.debris, self.rough_terrain))
        collect_debris.add_effect(self.object_at(self.debris, self.rough_terrain), False)
        collect_debris.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.debris), True)

        store_debris = InstantaneousAction("store_debris")
        store_debris.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage))
        store_debris.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.debris))
        store_debris.add_effect(self.object_at(self.debris, self.debris_storage), True)
        store_debris.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.debris), False)

        return navigate_to_garden, navigate_to_debris_storage, navigate_to_smooth_path, navigate_to_rough_terrain, equip_attachment, remove_attachment, check_terrain, collect_debris, store_debris

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_rough_terrain": And([
                self.attachment_equipped,
                self.terrain_is_uneven,
                self.obstacles_present
            ]),
        }
        
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.debris_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.debris, self.rough_terrain), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.impaired_attachment, self.debris_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_mobility_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.terrain_is_uneven, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.obstacles_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.terrain_checked(self.smooth_path), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.terrain_checked(self.rough_terrain), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.attachment_equipped, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.debris, self.debris_storage))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
